ValidationRule.description: Opportunities can only be closed/won if the Account KYC Status is approved. SAL-4201 Healthcare excluded 06/28/2024 BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", RecordType.Name <> "Bank-PSP Partner", RecordType.Name <> "Strategic Partner", RecordType.Name <> "Healthcare SOW", RecordType.Name <> "Healthcare", Probability > 0.8, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.KYC_Status__c , "Approved")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
